title: Leak Check
briefing: Optional specialism: environmental risk. Valtren's refrigeration plant lost 310 kg of refrigerant last year to leaks. The refrigerant has a high global warming potential, and leak records are incomplete.
Grace Mbeki asks for an environmental risk assessment before the next permit review.

evidence.title: Leak records
evidence.body: 310 kg topped up across six sites. Leak checks recorded at four sites; two sites have no records for 14 months.

evidence.title: Regulation (summary)
evidence.body: Systems above a size threshold need periodic leak checks with records; operators must repair leaks promptly; the phase-down restricts supply of this refrigerant from 2027.

evidence.title: Costs
evidence.body: Refrigerant price up 140% in two years. Leak detection sensors: 9,000 per site.

options.label: Non-compliance: missing leak-check records at two sites
Climate impact and reputational exposure from high-GWP leaks
Rising cost and future supply restrictions of the refrigerant

questions.prompt: How do you rate leak-check controls?

options.label: Ineffective at two sites (no records in 14 months), unproven elsewhere until checks are sampled
Effective overall: four of six sites have records, and the leaks are being found and topped up
options.feedback: Two sites with no evidence is a control failure.

options.label: Not rateable: missing records mean there is no evidence either way

questions.prompt: Sensors cost 54,000 for six sites. If they cut leaks by half and refrigerant costs about 120 per kg, what is the annual saving from refrigerant alone?

options.label: About 18,600 a year (155 kg x 120)
options.feedback: Half of 310 kg = 155 kg; x 120 = 18,600. Payback about 3 years before counting compliance and climate benefits.

options.label: About 54,000 a year (the sensors pay back in one year)
Fix records at two sites now, sensors at the two largest plants first, transition in the capital plan
options.feedback: Compliance first, then the best-value investment, then the long-term exposure.

options.label: Wait for the permit review and respond to whatever the regulator requires
options.feedback: The review will find the missing records.

options.label: Replace all plant with low-GWP systems now, ahead of the 2027 restrictions, to avoid future supply problems
options.feedback: Right direction, wrong timing and cost without a plan.

lesson: Environmental risk combines compliance, climate impact and cost. Fix the records first, invest where payback is clearest, and plan the transition.
